notes.title: The full version is Now Released! 🥳
notes.notes:
Hello Monuments Renovators! 🏛️

The long-awaited moment has just arrived and the game is available in its full version! 🥳

Our journey together lasted over a year through Early Access, during which time we received a lot of valuable information and feedback from you, which helped us direct the full version of Monuments Renovator. 😊

🔸 For players who decided to support us in Early Access, you don't have to do anything, you will only receive an update notification, which will give you the full version of the game.

🔸 For players who are joining us now, we have prepared several bundles with our partners, you can find the full list here -

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/666c79ebd030fcf190efb700f9db9cd68c901d46.png

The key differences that you can already see in the full version of the game are:1. Three new locations Great Wall, Luxor, Machu Picchu
2. Mini museum where we set the rewards obtained for completing the location
3. Tool repairs
4. Bug correction and optimization
5. GUI renewal

Thank you once again for your contribution to the development of Monuments Renovator and we can only invite you to play the full version of the game!

[previewyoutube=RDpoDZz-Cwg;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

Have fun!
Monuments Renovator Team

notes.title: Get Ready for the Full Version! 🥳
notes.notes:
Hello Renovators! 🏛️

We are thrilled to announce that the time has finally arrived to unveil the complete masterpiece of Monuments Renovator! 🎉 

On March 8, 2024, at 3:00 PM CET, we will be transitioning from Early Access to the Full Release 😊

In the Full Version of the game, you will be able to expect three new locations - the Great Wall, Luxor, and Machu Picchu - and other game improvements, which we will inform you about soon.

[previewyoutube=MKOyXoJqkl8;full][/previewyoutube]

This journey has been nothing short of extraordinary, as together, we've delved into the intricate art of restoring some of the world's most beautiful monuments. Thank you for every feedback 🤝

As we prepare for this monumental milestone in game development, we encourage you to mark your calendars and set your alarms for the release date. Let's celebrate this event together on March 8, 2024, at 3:00 PM CET.

Thank you for your support and dedication throughout this journey! 🙌

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

See you soon!
Monuments Renovator Team

Monuments Flipper: Prologue is launching on May 18th, 2022!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1664360/Monuments_Flipper_Prologue/

notes.title: Monuments Flipper | UPDATE AND FIXES
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We would like to thank you a lot for your feedback and your interest in playing the DEMO version of Monuments Flipper. If you haven't tried it out yet, you still have a chance to do it and share your feedback with us :) 

Thanks to your detailed reviews about your first impression of the demo, we are able to release a patch in order to help you improve your gameplay and fix all the issues that you've encountered. 

The list of changes:
- Added game launcher
- Post-processing fixed: motion blur, bloom
- Invert, fixed
- An alternative way to rotate items has been added: now it can be done with the arrows on the keyboard, or the renovation table mode SHIFT + arrows
- Vsync fixed
- Added the ability to display FPS (R key by default)
- Collider on crates increased - tiles should no longer fall under them
- Fixed bugs with resolution and screen mode
- Fixed bugs when changing graphics settings
- Fixed bugs with opening the door
- Added a new option in the information about the location, renovation documents

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3e65d784c083bfa26ef9d566026fec922b9a3ff5.png

The newest version with all the fixes you can download just now ;)
Once again, thank you so much for your feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png
